# Andrew - Carnegie Mellon University Web Hosting & Services

> Andrew is Carnegie Mellon's integrated web hosting platform providing course websites, personal pages, and academic publishing tools for faculty and students.

Andrew serves as the central hub for web-based services at Carnegie Mellon University, enabling faculty to publish course content and students to maintain personal web presence. The platform is managed by Carnegie Mellon Computing Services and integrates with the university's academic infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- CourseWeb
- UserWeb
- Web hosting
- Course websites

## Core Services

- [Andrew Homepage](https://www.andrew.cmu.edu): Carnegie Mellon's Andrew platform homepage for web hosting and course/user pages
- [CourseWeb](http://www.andrew.cmu.edu/courseweb): CourseWeb service for faculty course website publishing at Carnegie Mellon
- [UserWeb](http://www.andrew.cmu.edu/userweb): UserWeb service for personal web pages at Carnegie Mellon University

## Discovery & Browsing

- [Browse CourseWeb](http://www.andrew.cmu.edu/courseweb/browse.shtml): Browse and search Carnegie Mellon course websites by department
- [Browse Users](http://www.andrew.cmu.edu/userweb/browse.shtml): Search and browse Carnegie Mellon users by Andrew ID
